local function RUNE_fake_script() -- gui.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', gui)

	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local frame = script.Parent
	
	local dragToggle = nil
	local dragSpeed = 0.16
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	
	local function updateInput(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false

	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Players = game.Players
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer

	local function setupCollision(character)
		local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bodyParts = {}

		hrp.CanCollide = true

		local function addPart(part)
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hrp then
				table.insert(bodyParts, part)
			end
		end

		for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			addPart(part)
		end

		local descendantConnection = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(addPart)

		local heartbeatConnection
		heartbeatConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not character or not character.Parent then
				heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
				descendantConnection:Disconnect()
				return
			end

			for i = 1, #bodyParts do
				local p = bodyParts[i]
				if p and p.Parent then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if player.Character then
		setupCollision(player.Character)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCollision)
end)

local function GetLocationCenter(folder)
    if folder:IsA("Model") and folder.PrimaryPart then
        return folder.PrimaryPart.Position
    end
    local parts = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, d)
        end
    end
    if #parts == 0 then return nil end
    local sum = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do

    return sum / #parts
end

    local primary = model.PrimaryPart
    if primary then return primary.Position end

    local anyPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if anyPart then return anyPart.Position end

    if rakeConnection then return end
    rakeAccumulator = 0
    rakeConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not State.ShowRake then return end
        rakeAccumulator = rakeAccumulator + dt
        if rakeAccumulator >= RAKE_UPDATE_RATE then
            rakeAccumulator = 0
            scanForRake()

            local char = player.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                local myPos = root.Position
                for model, data in pairs(rakeEspCache) do
                    if data.distLabel and data.distLabel.Parent then
                        local pos = getRakeModelPosition(model)
                        if pos then
                            local dist = (pos - myPos).Magnitude
                            data.distLabel.Text = string.format("%d studs", math.floor(dist + 0.5))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

    end
    clearAllRakeESP()

        Saving = false

        Notify("saveinstance was not found.", 7)

        warn("[PulseCore] saveinstance is unavailable.")
        return
    end

    Notify(
        "Place saving started. The game may freeze temporarily.",
        7
    )

    task.wait(0.25)

    local FileName = string.format(
        "Place_%s_%s_FULL.rbxlx",
        tostring(game.PlaceId),
        os.date("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    )

    print("[PulseCore] Saving:")
    print(FileName)

    local Success, Result = pcall(function()
        return saveinstance({
            FilePath = FileName,
            Decompile = true,
            IgnoreDefaultProperties = false
        })
    end)

    Saving = false

    if Success then
        print("[PulseCore] Save completed.")
        print("[PulseCore] Result: " .. tostring(Result))

        Notify(
            "Place saved successfully.",
            7
        )

        return
    end

    warn("[PulseCore] saveinstance error:")
    warn(tostring(Result))

    Notify(
        "Save failed: " .. tostring(Result),
        10
    )
end

-- ============================================
-- CONTINUE BUTTON
-- ============================================

Continue.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not Running or Saving then
        return
    end

    Continue.Active = false
    Cancel.Active = false

    ScreenGui:Destroy()

    task.spawn(function()
        SavePlace()
    end)
end)

-- ============================================
-- CANCEL BUTTON
-- ============================================

Cancel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not Running then
        return
    end

    StopScript()
end)

-- ============================================
-- RIGHTSHIFT
-- ============================================

InputConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed or not Running then
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        task.spawn(function()
            SavePlace()
        end)
    end
end)

-- ============================================
-- START
-- ============================================

print("========================================")
print("[PulseCore] Place Saver loaded.")
print("[PulseCore] Waiting for Continue or Cancel.")
print("[PulseCore] RightShift = Save Place.")
print("========================================")

Notify(
    "Place Saver loaded.",
    5
)
scripts.features:
PulseCore Place Saver

PulseCore Place Saver is a lightweight Roblox utility script for saving the current place using the executor's `saveinstance` functionality.

Before saving, PulseCore displays a confirmation window explaining that the game may temporarily freeze while the place is being processed. The user can choose whether to continue or cancel the operation.

Features

Place Saver

Save the current Roblox place with `saveinstance`.

* Full place saving
* Script decompilation when supported
* Automatically generated filenames
* Uses the current Place ID and timestamp in the filename
* Manual saving with `RightShift`

Startup Confirmation

A PulseCore-styled confirmation window appears when the script starts.

It warns that the game may temporarily freeze during the save process.

`Continue` — Starts the place save.

`Cancel` — Cancels the operation and completely stops the script.

Roblox Notifications

Uses Roblox's built-in notification system instead of a custom notification GUI.

Notifications are shown for:

* Script loaded
* Save started
* Save completed
* Save failed
* Script cancelled
* Missing `saveinstance

Error Handling

The save operation is protected with error handling so failures can be reported through Roblox notifications without silently stopping the script.

Controls

`RightShift` — Save the current place again.

Requirements

The script requires an executor with a working `saveinstance` function.

Available `saveinstance` features and parameters may vary depending on the executor.
